aboutParas: Tree Top Tower Hire is a locally owned arboriculture and vegetation management business based in Ballarat East, with over 22 years in the industry.

Owners Jason and Laurinda Scholten run a team of 22 field staff, 5 office staff and a full-time mechanic, with yearly refresher training. Jason is a qualified arborist with an Advanced Certificate in Arboriculture.

Our fleet includes EWP towers from 13m to 23m, a Magni telehandler, stump grinders, chippers, 5T to 25T excavators, tipper trucks and support vehicles, so we can take on anything from a backyard tree to large-scale clearing.
